label: Visual Hierarchy Compression
purpose: Demote support graphics so target material/state response owns screen hierarchy without reducing interaction readability.

visualHierarchy.tertiary: support lines, rings, wireframes and transient cages

compression.relationshipAxis: hard axis hidden after targeting update and replaced by five-segment faded trace
compression.relationshipGlyphs: brief acquisition emphasis then lower sustained opacity
compression.pulse: large front/contour wireframes compressed more than return motion
compression.absorb: axis/funnel/filaments compressed more than moving fragments
compression.stabilize: tether and gyro rings compressed so target settling leads
compression.reactiveStress: strained/unstable/failing may restore a small amount of support emphasis only
